entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I think I need to return something. I was looking at the website and I'm just so confused by all the rules. It's about some cycling shoes I bought.
I can certainly help you look into that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I'm not sure what you mean. They just... they hurt my feet. I got terrible blisters on my first ride. I thought it was the cleats, so I moved them, but it didn't help. I just don't think they're right for me. Can't you just help me figure this out?

Of course, and I'm very sorry to hear the shoes were so uncomfortable. That's definitely not the experience we want you to have. Let me pull up your order. I see you received them 9 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that sounds about right. Does that mean I can't return them? I'm so lost.
Not at all. Since it's a standard item, you're well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. So I can send them back?

Yes, completely. I've just initiated the return on my end. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email now. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive the cycling shoes, your refund will be issued.
Wow, thank you so much! You've made this so easy.

It's my pleasure. And because you're a VIP member with us, I've also added a $20 credit to your account for the inconvenience. Hopefully, that can help you find a pair that's a much better fit next time.
That's so nice of you! Thank you, Charlie. You've been a great help.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Happy to help. Enjoy the rest of your day, and happy holidays from VeloFit.
